This program would include teaching and coaching youth on topics such as healthy relationships, safer sex practices and community safety, using developmentally appropriate engagement strategies; and would provide individual assessments, group workshops, and referrals to community-based organizations for youth and training for staff. item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
Pursuant to Section 3-05 of the NYC Procurement Policy Board Rules, it is the intent of the Administration for Children's Services ( ACS ) to enter into sole source negotiations with Iron Mountain Inc. located at One Federal Street, Boston, MA 02110. ACS expects that Iron Mountain, Inc., will be awarded a contract to provide current ACS case records currently stored in their warehouse by Sheltering Arms. Any vendor besides Iron Mountain that believes it can provide these services should contact Mr. Michael Walker at michael.walker2@acs.nyc.gov. Responses are due by Noon, July 6, 2026.

item.title: Fire Department — Procurement: Leica 3D Laser Scanning System
item.description:
Outcome: Procurement
The Bureau of Fire Investigation conducts investigations of all complex, fatal and suspicious fires within the City of New York to expertly determine their origin and cause. The Leica RTC 360 is a high-performance 3D terrestrial laser scanner known for its portability, speed, automated targetless registration, and integration with software. The use of Leica 3D scanning technology will significantly improve the Bureaus investigative operations.
